dct_description_sm: The rapid warming of the Arctic increases the degradation and melting of permafrost in northern Canada and accelerates the formation of thermokarst (thaw) lakes. Within the ADAPT Project (Arctic Development and Adaptation to Permafrost in Transition), our main research objectives will be to analyze the siliceous algal communities (diatoms and chrysophytes) in the thermokarst lakes of Nunavik.
dct_title_s: Past and present siliceous algal communities in subarctic thermokarst landscapes, Nunavik (Northern Qubec)
